summary: ansible.builtin.uri examples: check a URL returns 200, fail if content lacks a word with return_content and failed_when, POST JSON to create a JIRA issue with force_basic_auth and status_code 201, and log in to a form with body_format form-urlencoded (dict or list of tuples) and status_code 302.
questions: How do I check a web page returns 200 with Ansible?
How do I POST JSON with the uri module?
How do I submit a login form with Ansible uri?
How do I check page content with the uri module?

answer_card.title: Call an API with uri
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: https://your.jira.example.com/rest/api/2/issue/
    method: POST
    user: your_username
    password: your_pass
    force_basic_auth: true
    body: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.file','issue.json') }}"
    body_format: json
    status_code: 201

- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: http://www.example.com
    return_content: true
  register: this
  failed_when: "this is failed or 'AWESOME' not in this.content"
```
